author: SrtaaLauraa
body:
Age: 18

Timezone: UTC+2 ( Spain )

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes

Do you have Discord? Yes ( Im in the avicus discord yet)

Do you have access to a recording software? I have Action and OBS



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? Yes , I moderated 2 UHC servers and in MineLC ( its a server with +2000 players , its no premium but need moderation too )


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? My weakness its not related with the moderation so it dont affect anything ( Its that I cry eassily but I wont cry for moderating xd )


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? A leader must be a person who all the others persons have to appreciate and respect him , Must be a fair  person and have to get a really clair ideas of what he want and what to do in any moment. I dont see my self as a perfect leader but I can do it , I have my ideas ordenated and I always choose the better option when I have to take a decision


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? Disrespect , I think that we are here to have fun , and be suffering offenses its not tolerated. for example , before I was moderator , in MineLC I received
a lot of sexist insults like: Go to clean and stop playing or related. Its a game and every person must to enjoy it , so a calm atmosphere and good community its neccesary


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? You need to be fair with all the players , and always listen they , the players make the community , you cant be rude with they or talk to them with arrogance just because you  have a better rank that they . You dont have to forget that you was a normal player like them. Yes I have it


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating? Be fair , the rules are the rules for everybody. Be friendly , imagine that you do a tempban for combatlog and he appeal but its not accepted , you cant be rude with him because If you do , when the tempban ends he wont join again to the server. Try to help : The work of a moderator its not just  infractions , you have to help the community , for example with new players , If a new player spam in chat , try to tell him that its wrong , and If he still doing it , you have to punish him , but try always to speak and talk with the players. Obviously if he is blowing up their teammates its intentionally so it have to be punished and same with hacks and these types of punishments.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? I will talk to a higher staff about the situation. If its possible I will talk with the moderator about it  and why is he doing it , he must to know that without evidence a punishment its not valid.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? I probably will try to stop they , the staff must be like a family and we have to cooperate , I will say some positive things about the staff that its being harassed and try to change the point of view of the other players



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I will talk with a higher staff member about it , they have to be informated about everything to make this work better , and after I  will talk with the moderator who did it and try to know why he did it.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? I will record the situation and show it to an administrator , they are making feel bad to other players and thats not funny , to do a joke you dont have to alterate the server and you dont have to harass other players.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER


Why do you want to be a moderator? I have moderated more servers yet and its funny and the atmosphere with the staff its always good , we have to be like a family and thats always a good experience. Also I love to help other players , I think that its the way to improve the server and direct it to a better way.


What does Avicus mean to you? Its the most important server that I have , I have a lot of  friends here and I love the gamemodes and the competitive part.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? I think that its not bad , they are friendly and for what I see they always try to help everybody


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? Its a really nice server and it have a strong future , so I want to help the server to be in the good way to make this a perfect server


Do you have anything else to add to your application? I know that I dont have the 3 days spent on avicus but I hope that you can considerate my apply ^-^

- Do not meet criteria, 3 days of playtime.

You may not submit another application. Unless you manage to get enough playtime (3 days) before applications close, feel free to make another one. Thanks for applying!
